title: Rethinking Fixed-Horizon Latent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24001v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing latent reasoners typically run for a preset latent horizon during inference. Intuitively, a longer horizon should provide more opportunity for reasoning. However, in this work, we find that extending latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to the full preset horizon may in fact degrade reasoning performance. We observe that latent CoT evolves through distinct functional stages, with earlier computation forming frontier reasoning states, while later computation mainly reorganizes existing candidates and can weaken gold candidate support. These findings motivate a rethink of fixed-horizon latent inference. To address this, we characterize the reasoning benefits of latent CoT by realized and remaining constructive progress. Empirically, we find that higher realized constructive progress corresponds to higher current reasoning accuracy, while more remaining progress corresponds to larger future gains from continued latent CoT. translated_title: 重新思考固定长度的潜空间推理
translated_abstract: 现有的潜空间推理方法通常在推理阶段运行预设的潜空间推理长度。直觉上，更长的推理长度应该提供更多的推理机会。然而，在这项工作中，我们发现将潜空间思维链扩展到完整的预设长度实际上可能会降低推理性能。我们观察到潜空间思维链会经历不同的功能阶段：早期的计算形成前沿推理状态，而后期的计算主要是对已有候选进行重组，并可能削弱对正确候选的支持。这些发现促使我们重新审视固定长度的潜空间推理。为此，我们通过“已实现的建构性进展”和“剩余建构性进展”来刻画潜空间思维链带来的推理收益。实证结果表明，更高的已实现建构性进展对应更高的当前推理准确率，而更多的剩余进展则对应继续潜空间思维链所能带来的更大未来收益。
tldr: 该论文发现将潜空间思维链运行至完整预设长度反而可能损害推理性能，并提出用“已实现与剩余建构性进展”来刻画推理收益，为重新思考固定长度的潜空间推理提供了依据。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that extending latent chain-of-thought to the full preset horizon can actually degrade reasoning performance, and characterizes its benefits via realized and remaining constructive progress, motivating a rethink of fixed-horizon latent inference.
